existingContent.title: FAQ - Beatable Business Validation
existingContent.excerpt: FAQ - Beatable Business Validation Startup Validation Latest Startups Generate Idea Top Ideas Login Register Startup Validation Latest Startups Generate Idea Top Ideas Login Register Frequently Asked Questions Quick answers about validation, analysis, and how Beatable helps you win. General What is competitor analysis? A structured evaluation of alternative solutions in your space—direct and indirect—covering positioning, features, pricing, distribution, traction signals, and customer sentiment. It reveals gaps to differentiate and win. Why should I validate my idea? Validation reduces risk and waste. It confirms real demand, reachable customers, and a credible path to value before you commit serious time or money. What does validation mean? Validation is the process of demonstrating that a problem exists, customers will pay to solve it, and your solution can reach them profitably. What is a SWOT? SWOT stands for Strengths , Weaknesses , Opportunities , and Threats . It helps align internal capabilities with external realities to guide strategy. What is an ICP? ICP means Ideal Customer Profile—the specific segment most likely to buy, stay, and expand. It defines firmographics, pain points, budgets, and buying triggers. Strategy & Execution What is a pivot? A focused change in product, audience, pricing, or channel based on validated learning—preserving the vision while altering the strategy to achieve it. What is an actionable plan? A prioritized set of specific steps (who/what/when) tied to measurable outcomes—e.g., channels to test, features to build, pricing experiments, and success metrics. About Beatable What is Beatable? Beatable is an AI-powered platform that transforms ideas into validated strategies with competitor intelligence, market sizing, SWOT, ICP definition, and step-by-step action plans. Why use Beatable instead of ChatGPT or other AI tools? General chatbots are open-ended. Beatable is purpose-built for business validation: structured prompts, domain-specific analysis, visuals, and a consistent framework that turns insights into decisions—fast. Is Beatable an agent? Beatable orchestrates multiple analysis steps automatically, but it is not an autonomous agent that acts on your behalf. You stay in control of decisions and execution. How does Beatable create the analysis? We use a multi-agent workflow that breaks the task into specialized steps (market, competitors, pricing, positioning). Each step cross-checks reliable public sources and your inputs, then the results are merged into a single report. We include direct source references inside the analysis so you can verify and go deeper. Practicalities Where do insights come from? AI models synthesize public web data, market knowledge, and your inputs. We emphasize triangulation and caveats where uncertainty is high. How accurate is the analysis? Analyses are directional. Use them to shape hypotheses and experiments. Always validate critical assumptions with customers. How long does it take? Most full analyses complete in a few minutes using background queues. You’ll get notified when ready. Do you store my data? We store analyses in your account to let you revisit and build on them. See our Privacy Policy for details. Is it free? Beatable uses tokens for analyses and features. Check your balance in the dashboard and top up as needed. Can I export results? Yes. You can generate shareable reports and copy structured sections for decks and docs. Still have questions? Reach out and we’ll help you decide the fastest path to validation.
